Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Reliever of anxiety and Remover of sorrow

Arabic text: يَا رَحْمَانَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ وَ رَحِيمَهُمَا
Translation: O Most Compassionate in this world and the Hereafter, and Most Merciful in both

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And relieve my anxiety, and remove my sorrow

Arabic text: يَا وَاحِدُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
Translation: O the One, the Unique, the Eternal

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
Translation: O the One who does not beget nor was begotten
And there is none like unto Him
Protect me and purify me, and remove my affliction
In the Name of Allāh, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

Arabic text: اَللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
Translation: Allah is He besides Whom there is no god, the Everliving, the Self-subsisting by Whom all subsist;
slumber does not overtake Him nor sleep;

Arabic text: لَهُۥ مَا فِيْ السَّمَـٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِيْ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth is His;

Arabic text: مَن ذَا الَّذِيْ يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ
Translation: who is he that can intercede with Him but by His permission?

Arabic text: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ
Translation: He knows what is before them and what is behind them,

Arabic text: وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ
Translation: and they cannot comprehend anything out of His knowledge except what He pleases,
His knowledge extends over the heavens and the earth,
and the preservation of them both tires Him not,
and He is the Most High, the Great.
In the Name of Allāh, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of men,
The King of men,
The god of men,
From the evil of the whisperings of the slinking [Shaitan],
Who whispers into the hearts of men,
From among the jinn and the men.
In the Name of Allāh, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the dawn,
From the evil of what He has created,
And from the evil of the utterly dark night when it comes,
And from the evil of those who blow on knots,
And from the evil of the envious when he envies
In the Name of Allāh, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
Say: He, Allah, is One.
Allah is He on Whom all depend.
He begets not, nor is He begotten.
And none is like Him.

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ سُؤَالَ مَنِ اشْتَدَّتْ فَاقَتُهُ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You with the asking of one whose neediness has become severe
And whose strength has weakened, and whose sins have multiplied

Arabic text: سُؤَالَ مَنْ لَا يَجِدُ لِفَاقَتِهِ مُغِيثًا
Translation: The asking of one who finds no helper for his neediness
Nor any strengthener for his weakness
Nor any forgiver for his sin other than You
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ عَمَلًا تُحِبُّ بِهِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهِ
Translation: I ask You for actions through which You love those who perform them

Arabic text: وَيَقِينًا تَنْفَعُ بِهِ مَنِ اسْتَيْقَنَ بِهِ
Translation: And for certainty which benefits those who are certain of it
The true certainty in the fulfillment of Your command

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And take my soul in a state of truthfulness
And sever my need for this world
And make my desire for what is with You
In longing for meeting You
And grant me true reliance upon You

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ كِتَابٍ قَدْ خَلَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ
Translation: I ask You for the good of what has been written, and I seek refuge in You
From the evil of what has been written
I ask You for the fear of those who worship You
And the worship of those who are humble before You
And the certainty of those who rely upon You
And the reliance of the believers upon You
O Allah, make my desire in my requests
Like the desire of Your friends in their requests
And my fear like the fear of Your friends
And employ me in Your pleasure

Arabic text: عَمَلًا لَا أَتْرُكُ مَعَهُ شَيْئًا مِنْ دِينِكَ
Translation: With deeds that do not make me abandon anything from Your religion
Out of fear of anyone from Your creation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ حَاجَتِيْ فَأَعْظِمْ فِيهَا رَغْبَتِي
Translation: O Allah, this is my need, so magnify my desire for it

Arabic text: وَأَظْهِرْ فِيهَا عُذْرِي، وَلَقِّنِّيْ فِيهَا حُجَّتِي، وَعَافِ فِيهَا جَسَدِي
Translation: And make clear my excuse in it, and inspire me with my plea, and heal my body in it

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لَهُ ثِقَةٌ أَوْ رَجَاءٌ غَيْرُكَ
Translation: O Allah, whoever has awakened with confidence or hope in other than You
I have awakened and You are my confidence
And my hope in all matters
So decree for me the best outcome
And save me from the misleading trials
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ الْمُصْطَفَى
Translation: And may Allah bless our master Muhammad, the chosen Messenger of Allah
And upon his pure family
